therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Integrated behavioral intervention combining depression care management with cancer screening promotion
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Improvement in mental health outcomes and preventive care utilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Cancer screening uptake and depression symptom reduction

results.effect_size: Colorectal screening increased from 22.0% to 56.9% (CCI) vs 26.9% to 52.8% (PCM); PHQ9 decreased by 4.60 points (CCI) vs 5.05 points (PCM)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Significant improvements in cancer screening rates across all three types
biomarker_changes: PHQ9 depression scores decreased in both arms
subgroup_findings: No significant differences between intervention arms for most outcomes
safety_signals: One stroke event in collaborative care intervention arm

context.comparator: Prevention Care Management for Cancer Screening only
